name: Honeycomb Agent Observability
description: Honeycomb's agent observability with Agent Timeline, built on OTel GenAI conventions.
descriptionZh: Honeycomb 的 Agent 可观测能力，含 Agent Timeline，基于 OTel GenAI 语义约定。
keyFact: Honeycomb launched Agent Observability on 12 May 2026, introducing Agent Timeline for tracing agentic workflows without a proprietary SDK, based on OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions v1.40.0.
keyFactZh: Honeycomb 于 2026 年 5 月 12 日发布 Agent Observability，推出用于追踪 Agentic 工作流的 Agent Timeline，无需专有 SDK，基于 OpenTelemetry GenAI 语义约定 v1.40.0。
caveat: Agent Timeline was in Early Access at launch.
caveatZh: Agent Timeline 发布时处于 Early Access 阶段。
